##############################
# BOOKWORM - bookworm latest #
##############################

variable "BOOKWORM_VERSION" {
  validation {
    condition = BOOKWORM_VERSION != ""
    error_message = "The variable 'BOOKWORM_VERSION' must not be empty."
  }
}

variable "BUILD_DATE" {
  validation {
    condition = BUILD_DATE != ""
    error_message = "The variable 'BUILD_DATE' must not be empty."
  }
}

variable "DISTRO_NAME" {
  validation {
    condition = DISTRO_NAME != ""
    error_message = "The variable 'DISTRO_NAME' must not be empty."
  }
}

target "bookworm-latest-build" {
  dockerfile = "Dockerfile"
  args = {
    BOOKWORM_VERSION = "latest"
    BUILD_DATE = "${BUILD_DATE}"
    DISTRO_NAME = "bookworm"
  }
  tags      = ["bookworm/${BOOKWORM_VERSION}/${DISTRO_NAME}:${BUILD_DATE}"]
  platforms = ["linux/amd64", "linux/386", "linux/arm64"]
  output    = [{ type = "docker" }]
}

target "bookworm-latest-push" {
  dockerfile = "Dockerfile"
  args = {
    BOOKWORM_VERSION = "latest"
    BUILD_DATE = "${BUILD_DATE}"
    DISTRO_NAME = "bookworm"
  }
  tags      = ["registry.example.net/debian/bookworm:latest"]
  platforms = ["linux/amd64", "linux/386", "linux/arm64"]
  output    = [{ type = "registry" }]
}
